subject: Quick check — timing for pilot & your candid feedback
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: pilot scope & suggested next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a recommended next step so we can keep momentum: 

1) What we heard from Nimbus: primary goal is to reduce inference cost on your search reranking pipeline and bring 95th-pct latency under 120ms for 768-token contexts.
2) Suggested pilot scope: 2-week eval on a 50k qps-equivalent sample (non-PII), measure latency, token cost, and a small quality-side A/B on reranking precision.
3) Success criteria: match or beat current cost by 40% while keeping precision delta within 2 points; maintain P95 < 120ms.

Next step suggestion: 30-minute tech-scoping session with your infra/ML lead and our senior infra engineer (Ben) to confirm data format, sample cadence, and test harness. I’m proposing Wed 05/12 or Thu 05/13 (your time) — send a slot that works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachment: Discovery-Recap-20270510.pdf (one-pager + test plan)

If this doesn’t look like a fit right now, I’d really appreciate a quick candid note — saves you time and helps us prioritize.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.com)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbus.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@nimbus.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: pilot scope & suggested next steps

Thanks for the clear recap, Rachel — useful. I’ve shared this with Lina (CC’d) and our procurement team is taking a look at the sample/data access questions.

We’re interested, but I want to be transparent that Q3 budget planning is in flight and we may need to align timing. Lina, are you able to join a short scoping call next week?

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — timing for pilot & your candid feedback

Alex —

Wanted to follow up on this thread. Completely understand if budget/timing has shifted during your planning cycle. Quick asks: 

- Are you still exploring a pilot in the next 60 days, or has this been deprioritized for Q3?
- If it’s not a fit, could you share one sentence on why (timing, scope, budget, or other) so I can pass it back to the team?

If helpful, Ben is happy to join a 20-minute call to tailor the pilot scope (we can shrink to a short smoke test if that helps unblock procurement).

No pressure — a short note either way helps us and keeps things efficient on your side.

Thanks,
Rachel

Hi Rachel —

Appreciate the follow-up and very fair asks. Short update: after internal budget prioritization we’re deprioritizing new inference pilots for Q3 to preserve headroom for a cloud migration project. That said, the scope you outlined is interesting and I’d like to keep the conversation open for late Q3/early Q4 — can we reconnect in mid-August?

One quick piece of feedback: the pilot test harness looks sound, but procurement flagged the need for a short example SLA paragraph and a simple data handling diagram (non-PII flow). If you can send those two items it will help speed review next time.

Best,
Alex
